title: Refusal Is Not Robustness: Auditing Confident Fabrication in Large Language Models on a Provably Uninformative Clinical Pain Speech Transcript
abstract: arXiv:2608.26167v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hallucination and abstention benchmarks rarely establish that a model could not have known the correct answer, making it difficult to distinguish appropriate abstention from an unsupported prediction. Seven large language models were evaluated on the TAME Pain speech corpus. Participants read phonetically balanced Harvard Sentences while one hand was immersed in cold or warm water and reported pain only during periodic pain statements. This protocol generated 5,750 no signal Harvard Sentence utterances whose transcripts contained no lexical pain information and 1,294 signal pain statement utterances in which the pain rating was explicitly spoken. In the no signal arm, pain was recoverable from acoustic features (AUC 0.622, 95% CI 0.553 to 0.662), whereas transcript based prediction was near chance (AUC 0.489, 95% CI 0.418 to 0.504). translated_title: 拒绝并非鲁棒性：在可证明无信息的临床疼痛语音转录中审计大语言模型的自信捏造
translated_abstract: 幻觉和弃权基准很少能证明模型不可能知道正确答案，这使得区分适当的弃权与无根据的预测变得困难。研究在TAME疼痛语音语料库上评估了七个大型语言模型。参与者朗读语音平衡的哈佛句子，同时一只手浸入冷水或温水中，仅在周期性疼痛陈述期间报告疼痛。该协议生成了5,750条无信号的哈佛句子话语，其转录不包含词汇疼痛信息，以及1,294条信号疼痛陈述话语，其中疼痛评分被明确说出。在无信号组中，疼痛可从声学特征中恢复（AUC 0.622，95% CI 0.553至0.662），而基于转录的预测接近随机水平（AUC 0.489，95% CI 0.418至0.504）。由于自动语音识别移除了声学疼痛线索，任何仅从转录推断的疼痛评分都...
tldr: 该论文通过一个可证明无信息的临床语音转录场景，审计了大型语言模型在缺乏正确答案依据时的自信捏造行为，并揭示了拒绝机制并不能等同于鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper audits confident fabrication in large language models using a provably uninformative clinical pain speech transcript, showing that refusal is not equivalent to robustness.
